technique_name: Can you please provide a detailed answer for this question : Why is the price of goods higher in the market than on the internet?
description: The prices of goods are usually higher in the market than on the internet because of a variety of factors. Firstly, brick and mortar stores must factor in the cost of staffing and maintaining the storefront, which adds to the price of the goods they sell. Secondly, they must consider the cost of pay rent and utilities, which also adds to the overall cost.
